policy.selection: All seven completed self-hosted settings are paired with Terra none, the hosted GPT setting with the highest standalone log-AUC in the existing recordings. No pair is excluded based on its result; arbitration rules are unchanged from the Jev/GPT analysis.

auc_policy.aggregation: equal scenarios within family, then equal families
auc_policy.interpretation: Normalized area under in-force accuracy across environment intervals; equal multiplicative ranges have equal weight. This is a benchmark weighting rule, not an empirical deployment distribution.
auc_policy.selection: The AUC aggregation rule was adopted after inspecting the recorded passes; no recording was repeated or excluded.
